scorecard.rationale: Raw apple has no isolated clinical or whole-fruit Parkinson resting-tremor study: Parkinson motor-task cohorts used apples only as chewing/eating test props and mixed menus reported composite UPDRS only; isolated quercetin attenuated 6-OHDA rat muscle tremor (PMID:26217978) and harmaline mouse essential tremor (PMID:41354816, n=32, p<0.0001), but quercetin is ubiquitous across many foods and neither study tested an apple preparation.
